title: Mexican Deputies Propose 5 Billion Peso Cut to National Electoral Institute for 2027
author: Fernando Camacho and Enrique Méndez
content:
_This article by[Fernando Camacho and Enrique
Méndez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Fernando%20Camacho%20y%20Enrique%20M%C3%A9ndez)
originally appeared in the [October 30, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/30/politica/presupuesto-2027-diputados-
proponen-recorte-de-5-mil-millones-de-pesos-al-ine), Mexico's premier left
wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The Budget and Public Accounts Committee of the Chamber of
Deputies proposes a cut of **5 billion pesos** to the spending proposed by the
National Electoral Institute (INE), an amount that will be redistributed to
areas such as environmental protection, the improvement of educational
infrastructure, and the search for disappeared persons and civil aviation.

The draft opinion on the 2027 Federal Expenditure Budget Project (PPEF) –which
has already begun circulating among the legislators on said committee–
indicates that the cut to INE funds would be carried out without putting the
body's functions at risk, which would allow it to continue the process of
organizing next year's elections.

Originally, the INE had requested funds of 47,010 million pesos for 2027,
which already included a precautionary budget of 4,736 million pesos for
holding citizen consultations, and public financing for parties of 10,842
million.

According to the document of the San Lázaro Budget Committee, of the 5 billion
that would be taken from the electoral body's budget, **3 billion would go to
the La Escuela Es Nuestra program** of the Secretariat of Public Education,
whose objective is to improve the physical conditions, infrastructure and
services of basic and upper-secondary schools.

Another 1 billion would be allocated to the environmental sector, while 700
million would be redirected to the Federal Civil Aviation Agency and 300
million more to the National Search Commission for Persons (CNBP), a body
under the Secretariat of Governance responsible for defining, carrying out and
coordinating actions to search for, locate and identify disappeared and
missing persons.

## The 2027 PPEF Raises INE's Resources Compared to Past Elections

With the changes, the 2027 PPEF considers an amount of 42,274.5 million pesos
for the INE, a figure 20,437.3 million pesos higher than the 2026 PEF. Of the
amount projected for fiscal year 2027, 8,913.5 million pesos are proposed for
the guaranteed prerogatives of political parties, while 33,361.0 million pesos
are planned for the institutional activity Democracy Preserved and
Strengthened, through the organization of national elections, the promotion of
citizen participation and the promotion of the development of the party
system.

In this regard, the budgets approved in 2021 and in 2024 -years in which
elections were held- amounted to 26,819 million pesos and 32,767.0 million
pesos respectively, figures that, updated to 2027 prices, correspond to
34,799.9 million pesos and 36,665.5 million pesos, respectively.

In this context, the budget projected for the INE in fiscal year 2027 shows
**increases of 21.5 percent with respect to 2021 and of 15.3 percent with
respect to 2024** , figures that show amounts above what was approved for the
years cited in which elections were also held.

"In light of the above, the Budget Committee considers it viable to reduce the
INE's budget by approximately 15 percent, equivalent to 5 billion pesos, so
that in this way the body will have a budget allocation of 37,275.0 million
pesos in 2027," the project explains.

This proposal would not put the exercise of the INE's functions at risk
-according to the analysis carried out- and will allow it to continue
organizing the concurrent 2026-2027 federal electoral process and guarantee
the prerogatives of political parties and the exercise of citizens' political-
electoral rights.

## Increases for the Search for Disappeared Persons

As for the CNBP, it is estimated that although this program shows a nominal
increase of 8.0 million pesos for 2027, "the truth is that, in real terms this
represents a decrease of 2.5 percent, which is why it is proposed to
reallocate 300 million pesos," so that the Local Search Commissions are
reinforced in improving their technical and operational capacities and actions
to search for, locate and identify persons are implemented through the
granting of budgetary support aimed at strengthening these actions.

As for the Federal Civil Aviation Agency, the 2027 PPEF provides for an
allocation of 175.4 million pesos, which contrasts with the 685 million pesos
approved for it in the 2026 PEF.

The drafting Committee proposed reallocating resources to that body in the
amount of 700 million pesos, so that it has a budget allocation of 875.4
million pesos in 2027.

This "will allow it to be in a position to comply with what is established in
the National Air Navigation Plan, which includes a 15-year strategic vision
that seeks to align the body's operations with the standards of the
International Civil Aviation Organization, consolidating safe, efficient and
constantly growing aviation in order to recognize civil aviation as a
strategic sector for Mexico's connectivity and economic development."

## More Funds for Schools and the Environment

As for the La Escuela es Nuestra program, the Budget Committee found that its
budget allocation in the 2027 PPEF amounts to 20 billion pesos, which
represents **a decrease of 25.5 percent in real terms** compared to the amount
approved in the 2026 PEF.

"In view of the above, a reallocation of resources of 3 billion pesos is
proposed, so that the program has a budget allocation of 23 billion pesos in
2027, in order to continue improving the infrastructure, equipment and school
services of public basic and upper-secondary education communities,
prioritizing the principle of progressivity of rights in the public education
system."

As for Branch 16, Environment and Natural Resources, it has 49,508.3 million
pesos with which it will maintain a comprehensive environmental policy aimed
at guaranteeing every person's right to a healthy environment.

However, "a budget reallocation of 1.0 billion pesos is proposed, so that in
2027 it has a budget allocation of 50,508.3 million pesos, contributing to the
well-being of the population and the sustainable development of the country,"
the document indicated.
